out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED IN ONE-DOOR STANDING COOLER: RAW SHELL EGGS STORED ABOVE TOMATO SAUCE
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: EGGS MOVED TO THE BOTTOM SHELF. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Proper cooling time and temperature

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. OBSERVED STEAMED BROCCOLI AND CARROTS IN TWO-DOOR STANDING COOLER AT 45F. COOK STATED HE MADE THEM THE NIGHT BEFORE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CDI: DISPOSED OF. PIC RE-EDUCATED ON ADEQUATE COOLING PROCEDURES (WITHOUT A LID, PUTTING IN THE FREEZER TO RAPID COOL, ETC)

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN STEAM TABLE: CHILI AT 117F (1HR), TOMATO SAUCE AT 126F (1HR)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: FOODS TAKEN TO STOVE TO REHEAT TO 165F. ENSURE THE STEAM TABLE IS AT AN ADEQUATE TEMPERATURE TO KEEP TCS FOOD AT 135F OR ABOVE.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: OBSERVED NO ASTERISKS NEXT TO THE EGGS LISTED ON THE MENU WHICH ARE COOKED TO ORDER.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. CDI: EGGS ASTERISKED DURING THE INSPECTION. ENSURE ALL OF THE MENUS ARE CHANGED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. OBSERVED RESIDENTIAL PESTICIDE BEHIND THE BAR AND IN THE BASEMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CDI: PESTICIDES DISPOSED OF.

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED A FIRE EXTINGUISHER STORED NEXT TO PLATES, NAPKINS, AND SILVERWARE BEHIND THE BAR.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. CDI: FOOD CONTACT SURFACES RELOCATED. PIC RE-EDUCATED ON STORAGE OF TOXIC MATERIALS.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. Observed employee drinking from open container over food being prepped
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. PIC stopped employee and had them dispose of the open drinking containers

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quaternary ammonia solution was measured at 500+ ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of @SANITIZER@ solution at @##@ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. PIC diluted sanitizer solution to 200ppm.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 1 door upright glass front cooler ( 4 on report) did not have a working thermometer
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC replaced thermometer in the 1 door glass upright cooler

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: cardboard was observed in the walk in cooler and shelving in the dry storage rack on the cook line
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PIC asked cooks to remove the cardboard from the dry storage.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. Sanitizer test kits expired in 2024
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a @BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA, IODINE@ test kit. PIC ordered new test kits

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: BRUNCH MENU DID NOT HAVE A WRITTEN DISCLOSURE
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PIC AGREED TO REPRINT THE MENUS TO INCLUDE THE DISCLOSURE EHS WILL FOLLOW UP IN 10 DAYS TO VERIFY COMPLIANCE

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED PRE COOKED PORK BEING THAWED ON THE COUNTER OF THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK, NOT UNDER RUNNING WATER OR IN REFRIGERATION
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC MOVED THAWING PORK TO THE WALK IN COOLER TO FINSIH THAWING
